summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) that attaches @click range_clicked('name') metadata per column span, with output unchanged when no ranges are given; Opacity now replaces only the foreground color so segment meta is preserved; the layout resolver needed no edit because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size and fraction; added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; added the required clickable-range test in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/test_tabs.py. Nothing has been run, so tests are unverified. No commit was made. Choices beyond the spec: name and id appended to the Tabs constructor, duplicate names render only the last tab, on_key does not call super so app bindings are skipped while Tabs has focus.
